title: Rumors of elites having out-of-body experiences in pyramid granite chambers

tellings.quote: have you heard of rumors of sort of elite people you know uh spending time in Granite chamers in some of these pyramids like modern day

plain: The rumour is that wealthy and powerful people today spend time inside the granite chambers of some pyramids, and the story's label says they go there for out-of-body experiences. Michels brings it up himself as a question to a guest, asking whether they have heard these rumours, and he names no source.
